clauses.clause_label: 1(b) Grant of License to Cohere Products
clauses.scope_note: Covers Cohere Products procured through a Cohere resale Partner or installed on Partner-provided products, including applicable Cohere Models and Cohere Applications, plus Cohere-provided Documentation used to facilitate Client’s use. Grant is revocable, non-exclusive, non-sublicensable, and non-transferable. The Documentation access/use grant is also subject to compliance with the CLA; documentation may be updated at the referenced sites.
clauses.condition_explanation: The license applies during the Term, only for Client’s internal business purposes by its employees and contractors as Users, in accordance with Partner Terms, and subject to compliance with the CLA.

clauses.actor_role: Client; Users and third parties whom Client must not permit
clauses.scope_note: Restricts access to and use of the Cohere Products. The operative restrictions below specify particular prohibited uses and acts.
clauses.condition_explanation: Access or use is prohibited when it is not expressly permitted by both the CLA and the Partner Terms.

clauses.actor_role: Client; Users and third parties whom Client must not permit
clauses.scope_note: Applies to access to or use of Cohere Products. Documentation includes Cohere’s Usage Policy, which may be updated by Cohere from time to time.
clauses.condition_explanation: Use is prohibited if any listed circumstance applies: violation of law or Documentation/Usage Policy; infringement or misappropriation of protected rights, including processing Client Data without necessary consents and licenses; or adverse effect on Cohere’s reputation, goodwill, trademarks, or specified relationships.

clauses.actor_role: Client; Users and third parties whom Client must not permit
clauses.scope_note: The prohibition covers access to or use of Cohere Products and use of Client Output. Examples include building a competitive AI model and generating training data for large language models. The competitor restriction includes entities offering large language models for license or sale.
clauses.condition_explanation: The specified use is prohibited when its purpose is to build or train a similar or competitive product/service, develop an application replicating the Products’ look and feel, or benefit a direct competitor as reasonably determined by Cohere. The listed grounds are alternatives.

clauses.actor_role: Client; Users and third parties whom Client must not permit
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits distributing, sublicensing, reselling, permitting access to, or otherwise making Cohere Products available to any third party. The clause does not state an exception for paid or unpaid access.

clauses.actor_role: Client; Users and third parties whom Client must not permit
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits modifying, decompiling, reverse engineering, reverse assembling, or disassembling Cohere Products, and otherwise accessing or modifying their source code.

clauses.actor_role: Client; Users and third parties whom Client must not permit
clauses.scope_note: The restriction concerns proprietary notices or labels on Cohere Products; the text does not impose a general notice obligation for copies or distributions.
clauses.condition_explanation: Use-related conduct is prohibited when it involves removing or obscuring proprietary notices or labels.

clauses.actor_role: Client; Users and third parties whom Client must not permit
clauses.scope_note: Restricted Locations expressly include Belarus, China (including Hong Kong and Macau), Cuba, Iran, North Korea, and Russia, Syria, and locations Cohere may advise Client are restricted from time to time.
clauses.condition_explanation: Access to or use of Cohere Products from a Restricted Location is prohibited.

clauses.scope_note: Client is solely responsible for its Client Environment and its security. Client Environment means an on-premise or private cloud environment owned by or under Client’s control.
clauses.condition_explanation: The responsibility applies in connection with Client’s use of Cohere Products.

clauses.clause_label: 3(b) Validation of use and Client Outputs
clauses.scope_note: Client is solely responsible for evaluating Cohere Products and Client Outputs for accuracy and appropriateness for its use cases, including deciding where human review is appropriate. Client Outputs exclude specified anonymous, aggregated Usage Data that cannot identify or reveal an individual user.
clauses.condition_explanation: The evaluation responsibility applies when evaluating the Products or Outputs for Client’s use cases; the clause does not grant rights to use or distribute Outputs.

clauses.scope_note: Client must keep login credentials secure, provide them only to authorized Users, not share them between unique Users, and is responsible for unauthorized access or use using those credentials.
clauses.condition_explanation: These duties apply to Client Credentials used to access Cohere Products.

clauses.scope_note: Cohere or its licensors retain ownership and intellectual property rights in Cohere Products, including Modifications made to them; rights not expressly granted are reserved. Products are licensed or made available, not sold. This is an ownership/reservation clause, not an additional permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: No independent activity permission or prohibition is stated here.

clauses.scope_note: Cohere makes no claim to ownership of Client Outputs or Client Inputs. Client Data excludes Usage Data and Feedback and is not part of the Cohere Products. This statement does not itself grant Client an express license to use or distribute data or Outputs.
clauses.condition_explanation: No independent activity permission or prohibition is stated here.

clauses.actor_role: Cohere is grantee; Client is grantor
clauses.scope_note: Client grants Cohere a nonexclusive, worldwide, royalty-free, irrevocable, sublicensable, transferable, fully paid-up right to access, collect, use, process, store, disclose, and transmit Client Inputs to provide Cohere Products and to exercise Cohere’s rights and perform its obligations, including checking Client’s compliance with the CLA and Usage Policy. Client Inputs are data, information, content, records, and files entered into, transmitted to, or made available by Client to Cohere Models or the Client Environment for processing.
clauses.condition_explanation: The granted rights are limited to the two stated purposes and are exercised pursuant to the CLA.

clauses.scope_note: Client must provide Cohere, directly or through Partner as Cohere specifies, a usage information report for each Cohere Product instance, using Cohere’s Usage Report and supplying requested information. The report will not require Confidential Information contained in Client Data.
clauses.condition_explanation: The reporting duty concerns Client’s use of each Product instance; the route of submission is as Cohere may specify.

clauses.scope_note: Cohere, Partner, or an independent auditor chosen by Cohere may inspect and audit use under the CLA on ten days’ prior written notice, during the Term and for one year afterward, during regular business hours and without unreasonable interference. Client must provide reasonable assistance and reasonably requested access to information.
clauses.condition_explanation: Client’s assistance duty applies to an audit conducted under the clause’s notice, timing, and manner requirements.

clauses.scope_note: Client must ensure Cohere does not receive or otherwise process personal data or personal information under applicable privacy laws unless Client has requested and executed Cohere’s Data Processing Addendum, directly or via Partner as Cohere specifies.
clauses.condition_explanation: Personal data may be received or processed only if Client has requested and executed the specified Data Processing Addendum.

clauses.scope_note: Client is responsible for paying Partner applicable fees and taxes related to use of Cohere Products, as set out in Partner Terms. Failure to pay may result in termination of the CLA; termination is stated as a possible consequence, not an automatic event.
clauses.condition_explanation: Payment is required for applicable fees and taxes specified in the Partner Terms; their amounts and applicability are not supplied in this chunk.

clauses.scope_note: Client must protect and keep Cohere Confidential Information confidential and disclose it only as necessary to comply with applicable laws compelling disclosure. At Cohere’s request, or upon expiration or termination of the CLA, Client must destroy, return, or delete such information in its possession. Confidential Information includes Cohere Products and reproductions, summaries, analyses, or extracts.
clauses.condition_explanation: Confidentiality applies to Cohere Confidential Information encountered while using the Products; the law-compelled disclosure is the stated exception. Destruction, return, or deletion is triggered by Cohere’s request or CLA expiration or termination.

coverage_notes: Scope is a Client License Agreement for Cohere Products obtained through a resale Partner or installed on Partner-provided products, not a general repository or open-source software license. The Partner Terms, Order Form, Scope of Work, Term definition, and full Product Schedule are not provided here; product entitlements, fees, and applicability may depend on them.

The Usage Policy and Documentation are incorporated by reference and may be updated; their substantive terms are not included in this chunk. The Data Processing Addendum is referenced but not supplied.

The text states no claim to ownership of Client Inputs or Outputs but grants no express Client license to use or distribute them in this chunk. The Client Input license is a grant from Client to Cohere, not a Client permission concerning a licensed artifact.

No express permission to copy, modify, combine, train, commercially exploit, distribute, sublicense, host, or provide network access to Cohere Products beyond the narrow internal-use license is stated. The restriction on modification and third-party availability is explicit; silence is not treated as a grant.
Section 3(b) defines Usage Data as excluded from Client Outputs, and section 4(b) excludes Usage Data and Feedback from Client Data; no operative rights over Usage Data or Feedback are supplied here.

The general acceptance and authority representations, audit right itself, and warranty disclaimers are not extracted as ASC permissions or restrictions. No termination, restoration, cure period, patent retaliation, source-provision, attribution, or copyleft terms appear in the supplied lines.
